ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
你还是不开心的话……
我给你烤个蛋糕吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text: PAREO很担心你哦。怕你在哭呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
啊~好冷~
在这种时期骑摩托车太可怕了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 今天那家伙没来吗？戴眼镜的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
舞台？
……嗯？里面好像传来了一些声音……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
那家伙……
弹吉他……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 把刚刚的R·I·O·T弹给那群家伙听

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 给，把头盔戴上。走了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 噢，PAREO。我带她来了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我们又不会吃了你，放心吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
是吗。那让我听听你的演奏吧。
音乐是不会说谎的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
R·I·O·T。
这家伙只听了一次就会了。
你能弹吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
刚刚在Galaxy舞台弹琴的时候，你的演奏更加的……
该怎么说呢——

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 话说那家伙是不是对Roselia太执着了？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
CHU²……
就听一下她真心的演奏吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 那家伙……打算把贝斯和键盘的部分都弹出来？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
听到这样的演奏，
我们怎么可能不和你一起组乐队呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text: CHU²，你觉得呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 哈？（暂定）？那是什么？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
哦哦！真是一把好吉他啊！
你拿着它看起来好可爱

啊~好冷~
在这种时期骑摩托车太可怕了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_003
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 今天那家伙没来吗？戴眼镜的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_004
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
舞台？
……嗯？里面好像传来了一些声音……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_005
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
那家伙……
弹吉他……

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_006
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 把刚刚的R·I·O·T弹给那群家伙听

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_007
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 给，把头盔戴上。走了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_008
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 噢，PAREO。我带她来了

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_009
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 我们又不会吃了你，放心吧

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_010
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
是吗。那让我听听你的演奏吧。
音乐是不会说谎的

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
R·I·O·T。
这家伙只听了一次就会了。
你能弹吧？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_012
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
刚刚在Galaxy舞台弹琴的时候，你的演奏更加的……
该怎么说呢——

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_013
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 话说那家伙是不是对Roselia太执着了？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
CHU²……
就听一下她真心的演奏吧

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_015
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 那家伙……打算把贝斯和键盘的部分都弹出来？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_016
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
听到这样的演奏，
我们怎么可能不和你一起组乐队呢

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_017
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: CHU²，你觉得呢？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_018
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 哈？（暂定）？那是什么？

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_019
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text:
哦哦！真是一把好吉他啊！
你拿着它看起来好可爱

heart_speech_0_1_0#2.name: voice_020
heart_speech_0_1_0#2.text: 不用道歉，我明白你的心情

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_000
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
你还是不开心的话……
我给你烤个蛋糕吧？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_001
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: PAREO很担心你哦。怕你在哭呢
